header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.arabic_text: نَصَرَ قَوْمَهُ عَلَي غَيْرِ الْحَقِّ فَهُوَ كَالْبَعِيْرِ الَّذِيْ رُدِّيَ فَهُوَ يُنْزَعُ بِذَنَبِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب فِي العصبية رقم :٥١١٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The example of one who helps his own people in an unjust manner is like a camel that has fallen into a well being pulled out of the well by its tail.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Just as it is impossible to pull out a camel that has fallen into a well by holding its tail, in the same way, one cannot attain honour by helping one's own group in an unjust manner.
(Majma' Bihar al-Anwar)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ دَعَا اِلَي عَصَبِيَّةٍ، وَلَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ قَاتَلَ عَلَي عَصَبِيَّةٍ، وَلَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ مَاتَ عَلَي عَصَبِيَّةٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في العصبية رقم:٥١٢١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jubair ibn Mut'im (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever calls others to help his own people in an unjust manner is not of us. Whoever joins his own people and fights in an unjust manner (carried away by emotion) is not of us. And whoever dies fighting in an unjust manner to protect his own people is also not of us.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ فُسَيْلَةَ رَحِمَهَا اللهُ اَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ اَبَاهَا يَقُوْلُ: سَاَلْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ فَقُلْتُ: يَارَسُوْلَ اللهِ! أَمِنَ الْعَصَبِيَّةِ اَنْ يُحِبَّ الرَّجُلُ قَوْمَهُ، قَالَ: لَا، وَلكِنْ مِنَ الْعَصَبِيَّةِ اَنْ يَنْصُرَ الرَّجُلُ قَوْمَهُ عَلَي الظُّلْمِ.
